title: Paste your product/app/SaaS URL into the workflow to auto-generate UGC based on…
content:
Paste your product/app/SaaS URL into the workflow to auto-generate UGC based on your site content.  
Pick an AI persona by selecting both a face and a voice before generating the UGC.  
Use Hermes Agent to scrape Meta Ads Library and TikTok Creative Center to pull winning hooks and formats, then base your UGC script/structure on those.  
Use Seedance 2.0 to generate the UGC while overlaying your actual product screenshots on-screen.  
Export the generated UGC in the required aspect ratio format (9:16, 1:1, or 16:9).

Elige una persona de IA seleccionando tanto un rostro como una voz antes de generar el UGC.

Usa Seedance 2.0 para generar el UGC mientras superpones capturas de pantalla reales de tu producto en pantalla.  
Exporta el UGC generado en el formato de relación de aspecto requerido (9:16, 1:1 o 16:9).
